neighbours.label: The punctuation that closes a press-release dateline ('DUBLIN, Ohio, 10 October 2012—', 'CHAMPAIGN, Ill. -', 'SAN DIEGO, Dec. 27, 2016 –', '(BUSINESS WIRE)--') before the story starts; the same places and dates in ordinary prose stay quiet.

TORONTO, Ontario — The university named a new president on Friday.
MADISON, Wis. — A new study finds that bees prefer purple flowers.

notes: Card: peaks on '.\n', '.', ' -', ')—', '—', '.--' right after news datelines (DUBLIN, Ohio, ... 2012—; CHAMPAIGN, Ill. -; FOSTER CITY, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--) and after 'For more information, visit www...'. Exploratory probe: datelines 0.35-0.63; the same facts in prose 0.005-0.055.
